mapper.sql: gid, geom, layertype, calarea, bsm, ysdm, gzqlxdm, gzqmj, sm
mapper.update: update ${tableName} set minx = ST_X ( st_astext ( st_pointn ( ST_ExteriorRing ( ST_Envelope ( geom ) ), 1 ) ) ), miny = ST_Y ( st_astext ( st_pointn ( ST_ExteriorRing ( ST_Envelope ( geom ) ), 1 ) ) ), maxx = ST_X ( st_astext ( st_pointn ( ST_ExteriorRing ( ST_Envelope ( geom ) ), 3 ) ) ), maxy = ST_Y ( st_astext ( st_pointn ( ST_ExteriorRing ( ST_Envelope ( geom ) ), 3 ) ) ), calarea=st_area(st_transform(geom, CAST ( ( FLOOR ( ( ST_X ( st_centroid ( geom ) ) + 1.5 ) / 3 ) + 4488 ) AS INTEGER ))) where calarea is null;
mapper.select:
SELECT row_to_json(fc) FROM ( SELECT 'FeatureCollection' AS type, '212' AS id, array_to_json(array_agg(f)) AS features FROM ( SELECT 'Feature' AS type
,ST_AsGeoJSON(geom)::json as geometry
,( SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM ( SELECT bsm as tbbh,bsm,gzqmj as area ) AS t ) AS properties FROM ${tableName}
and bsm like concat('%',#{req.tbbh},'%')
limit ${size} offset ${offset} ) AS f ) AS fc

select count(1) from ${tableName}
and bsm like concat('%',#{req.tbbh},'%')
mapper.delete: delete from ${tableName} where BSM is null or GZQMJ is null
